$comment: The set of legal documents this build serves, and the only source of LegalDocument rows.
LegalDocumentCatalog reads this at startup, hashes each file's bytes into ContentHash and
upserts one row per (documentType, version). Adding a version means adding an entry here and
a file beside it - never editing a published file in place, which is exactly what ContentHash
Versions are ordered by effectiveAt, not by string comparison: the 'current' document of a
type is the one with the latest effectiveAt that is not in the future.
Versions are the document's own 'last updated' date. These are the real published documents,
sourced from the alpine-angular-landing repo (src/app/components/legal); the placeholders they
replaced were never deployed. Any change here must be mirrored in that repo, or venta.gg and
